summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC) reporting its April 2026 monthly revenue (NT$22,663,945 thousand, up 10.80% year-over-year), along with disclosures that there were no funds lent to other parties, no endorsements or guarantees, and minimal financial derivative activity. It also includes a certification by the CFO. This is a standard operational update with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is entirely routine and does not contain any transaction, strategic review, or corporate action that would classify it as a special situation.
